items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: Chick Martin and I, we used to go, go to, to Thompson's restaurant, and then after that we'd go to church on Saturday morning.

ctx.x: And then, then, of course, if the job paid enough money, they added a bass. See? You know, that suck-in thing that Chick Martin invented himself, you know. Oh, yeah. And, and he, he was, Chick Martin and I, we used to go, go to, to Thompson's restaurant, and then after that we'd go to church on Saturday morning. Mm-hmm. So, the judge was church when I was working at the Absinthe House,…
